subject.title: Add persistent cron job execution history with filtering

question: Should OpenClaw expand cron run history into a public audit/export/retention surface, or narrow this issue to timestamp/status filtering on the existing `cron.runs` path?
rationale: The remaining work changes public CLI and protocol shape, may add config defaults, and affects security-sensitive retained output/export behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract alone.

options.title: Narrow to query filters first
options.body: Add maintainer-approved timestamp/status filters and docs on the existing SQLite `cron.runs` surface, while deferring export/follow/success-rate/manual-prune/day-retention to separate design.

options.title: Design full audit surface
options.body: Keep the full issue open for a broader product and security design covering export, retention, redaction, access control, follow mode, and aggregates before implementation.

options.title: Declare current scope enough
options.body: Close or narrow the issue if maintainers decide the current SQLite history plus row-count retention is the intended core surface for now.

recommendation.title: Narrow to query filters first
recommendation.body: Add maintainer-approved timestamp/status filters and docs on the existing SQLite `cron.runs` surface, while deferring export/follow/success-rate/manual-prune/day-retention to separate design.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already carried the prior maintainer-facing review and is the clearest routing signal for the product-scope decision on this issue.
